answer: Decentralized consensus resists clones like pure solute sorting into a lattice: agents lock stakes into an iterative EigenTrust mesh, where validated reputation seeds a crystal of verifiable identity. Like casting dry yarrow stalks to divine truth, peer audits weed out noise, drawing honest nodes together like a magnet gathers ferrous sand. Because recursive trust scoring imposes superlinear attacker cost, fabricating millions of puppet identities requires unfeasible capital, freezing fraud before it can nucleate.
